fields.title: Read the schema
fields.inputs/0/label: Price at which the item was bought, in history
fields.inputs/1/label: Order payment split between two users
fields.inputs/2/label: Cancellation of a single item from an order
fields.inputs/3/label: All user orders for the month
fields.inputs/4/label: Price comparison of an item across different stores
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Given the Polka schema. Mark which of the five features require schema changes and which work on the existing one.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Show the price at which the item was bought in history
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Split order payment between two users
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Cancel a single item from an order while keeping the rest
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Show all user orders for the month
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/4: Compare the price of a single item across different stores
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 and 4 — on existing (price lives in order item; order→user relation exists). 2, 3, 5 — require changes: 2 changes relationship cardinality, 3 requires item status, 5 requires a new catalog item entity. The key to the exercise is distinguishing between "missing data" and "missing structure": the first is backfilled, the second is rebuilt.
